newsitem.title: FRANCE: Danzas sees Q1 air freight growth.
newsitem.headline: Danzas sees Q1 air freight growth.

text.p: Air cargo tonnage handled by Swiss freight forwarder, Danzas AG continued to grow in first quarter 1997 after a significant increase in tonnage and turnover in 1996 over the previous year, a Danzas official said on Tuesday.

1996 net turnover from airfreight totalled 675 million Swiss francs compared to 611 million the previous year with 20 percent sales growth in the Far East and 30 percent in Latin America -- two regions of the globe where Danzas does not have a strong presence, a Danzas official told Reuters by telephone from Basle.
"Growth in Latin America was centred largely on Argentina but development in this region has also included the opening of offices in Peru and Ecuador and more recently, in Brazil," he said.

"As for the Far East, Hong Kong and Singapore were two expanding markets for us. In North America, where we already have a good market share, we recorded five percent sales growth," the official added.
Danzas' 1996 gross profits from airfreight totalled 157 million Swiss francs compared to 146 million in 1995, he said
The group's 1996 global airfreight volume totalled 357,000 tonnes compared to 306,000 tonnes in 1995, he said. Danzas global net sales last year totalled 4.05 billion Swiss francs.
